title: My Neighborhood
text:
My neighborhood is small and quiet. There is a park near my house. Many children play there after school. I like the big green trees in the park. There is also a small shop on the corner.

My neighbor is Mrs. Brown. She has a small dog named Max. Every morning she walks Max in the park. On Sundays, we have lunch together in her garden. I like my neighborhood very much.

questions.text: What is the name of my neighbor?
Why do many children like the park?
options: Because it is a place to play

questions.text: How does the writer feel about the neighborhood?

vocabulary.definition: an area where people live near each other
a place where you buy things
a place with plants outside a house

paragraph_translations: Moja okolica jest mała i cicha. Przy moim domu jest park. Po szkole wiele dzieci bawi się tam. Lubię duże zielone drzewa w parku. Na rogu jest też mały sklep.
Moja sąsiadka to pani Brown. Ma małego psa o imieniu Max. Każdego ranka spaceruje z Maxem po parku. W niedziele jemy razem obiad w jej ogrodzie. Bardzo lubię moją okolicę.
